curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with backing and opening doors, then where and how to park, hill parking with and without a curb, and the places and distances where parking is banned.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for backing versus exiting, curb versus no-curb hills, and place bans versus distance bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on backing, parking and parking bans.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach scanning for risks, when headlights are required, low-beams versus high-beams, handling glare and driving in fog.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for scanning versus headlights, low versus high beams, and glare versus fog.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on visibility, headlights and beams.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover slowing and doubling the gap in poor conditions, rain and hydroplaning, clearing snow and ice, and stopping on slick surfaces.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for rain versus snow and for slick braking versus the doubled gap.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on driving in rain, snow and ice.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how Virginia law defines aggressive driving, the behaviors it covers, how to respond to an aggressor and the license penalty.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for the legal definition versus the behaviors and for your response versus the court's.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec10-m01..sec10-m04; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
